full_name: Ludwig Straub | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Harvard University
bio: Ludwig Straub is a macroeconomist at Harvard University whose main research focus is on building and simulating macroeconomic models that allow for heterogeneity among households, such as in income or wealth.
